summary: Unnamed solo hiker stranded and immobile on a rocky ledge in North Cheyenne Cañon Park during a passing Arctic front with subzero temperatures and wind chills near -30°F; raised the alarm early Saturday morning; Colorado Springs Fire Department used a drone to locate the hiker in steep terrain, then completed a complex rope rescue with a team hiking to the patient's location; transported to the hospital with frostbite and other injuries; several firefighters suffered cold-exposure symptoms and were treated at the scene.
notes: Date pinned: article published ~2024-01-16 with story framing "raised the alarm early on Saturday morning" → Saturday 2024-01-13, weekday-verified; incident fell during the mid-January 2024 Arctic blast.
